title: Glowing guitar
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Guitar body - warm golden glow -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='68' rx='22' ry='26' fill='#FFB020'/>
  <!-- Body lower bout highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='74' rx='18' ry='19' fill='#FFD060'/>
  <!-- Body upper bout -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='52' rx='16' ry='16' fill='#FFB020'/>
  <!-- Waist cut -->
  <rect x='20' y='62' width='44' height='10' rx='3' fill='#FFB020'/>
  <!-- Sound hole - dark but lit -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='64' r='7' fill='#2A1A00'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='64' r='5' fill='#FF7020'/>
  <!-- Bridge -->
  <rect x='36' y='78' width='12' height='4' rx='1' fill='#E06010'/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x='38' y='18' width='8' height='38' rx='2' fill='#C08030'/>
  <!-- Fret lines - lighter edge -->
  <line x1='38' y1='26' x2='46' y2='26' stroke='#FFD080' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='38' y1='32' x2='46' y2='32' stroke='#FFD080' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='38' y1='38' x2='46' y2='38' stroke='#FFD080' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='38' y1='44' x2='46' y2='44' stroke='#FFD080' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='38' y1='50' x2='46' y2='50' stroke='#FFD080' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- Headstock -->
  <rect x='36' y='10' width='12' height='10' rx='2' fill='#A06020'/>
  <!-- Tuning pegs -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='13' r='1.8' fill='#FFE080'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='17' r='1.8' fill='#FFE080'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='13' r='1.8' fill='#FFE080'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='17' r='1.8' fill='#FFE080'/>
  <!-- Strings -->
  <line x1='40' y1='18' x2='40' y2='56' stroke='#FFE8A0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='42' y1='18' x2='42' y2='56' stroke='#FFE8A0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='18' x2='44' y2='56' stroke='#FFE8A0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- Glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='68' rx='30' ry='34' fill='none' stroke='#FFD060' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <path d='M70 30 L72 36 L78 38 L72 40 L70 46 L68 40 L62 38 L68 36 Z' fill='#FFF0A0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M24 36 L25 39 L28 40 L25 41 L24 44 L23 41 L20 40 L23 39 Z' fill='#FFF0A0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M74 58 L75.5 61 L78 62 L75.5 63 L74 66 L72.5 63 L70 62 L72.5 61 Z' fill='#FFE060' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
